# wavelngth, n - merged, LXe data and sellmeir calc for wavelengths > 200nm. actually from fluid bands - Laporte (UV) and sinnock - (Vis). not sure where the static dielectric = n^2 value comes from. Razvan's old data file uses 1.34-->1.8  as final value. Conti webpage gives eps = 1.96 --> 1.4 which gives the fixed value of grace/munroe paper at 178
